r35.floor_plans_root_cause: compliance-tracker/src/lib/supabase/auth-guard.ts:398-404 -- requireAuthOrApiKey() unconditionally calls requireAuth() FIRST even for a pure Bearer-API-key request with no session cookie at all (exactly how projexa's server-to-server calls authenticate). requireAuth() (auth-guard.ts:270-272) does a real network round-trip via supabase.auth.getUser() before validateApiKey() is ever reached -- a wasted call on every single API-key-authenticated request. DB layer ruled out: interior_floor_plans has only 12 rows and a correct composite index (org_id, project_id) matching the query exactly; its RLS policy and current_org_id() are both trivial.
